new = '''def pareto(triples):
    """Keep the (work, pages, resident) frontier; drops dominated options."""
    triples.sort()
    out = []
    for work, pages, resident in triples:
        dominated = False
        for w2, p2, r2 in out:
            if w2 <= work and p2 <= pages and r2 <= resident:
                dominated = True
                break
        if dominated:
            continue
        out = [x for x in out if not (work <= x[0] and pages <= x[1]
                                      and resident <= x[2])]
        out.append((work, pages, resident))
    return out


def brute_optimum(starts, hops, bursts, C, hit, miss, dec, fixed=0):
    """Exact minimum (work, image_pages) over every legal layout.

    fixed is the version's constant page cost (header plus padded hop array).
    """
    R = len(starts)
    weights = [0] * R
    hitsets = []
    for repeat, addresses in bursts:
        runs = [bisect.bisect_right(starts, a) - 1 for a in addresses]
        for k in runs:
            weights[k] += repeat
        hitsets.append((repeat, set(runs)))
    wsum = [0]
    for x in weights:
        wsum.append(wsum[-1] + x)

    def Q(i, j):
        return wsum[j] - wsum[i]

    def T(i, j):
        t = 0
        for repeat, hs in hitsets:
            if any(i <= k < j for k in hs):
                t += repeat
        return t

    def ok(i, s, m):
        if m == 0:
            return True
        spread = starts[i + s - 1] - starts[i]
        return spread < (1 << (64 if m == 1 else 32))

    memo = {}

    def options(i, s):
        if (i, s) in memo:
            return memo[(i, s)]
        triples = []
        if s <= 8:
            for m in range(3):
                if not ok(i, s, m):
                    continue
                P = (32 + s * WIDTH[m] + 63) // 64
                coeff = (s + LANES[m] - 1) // LANES[m] + dec[m]
                base = coeff * Q(i, i + s)
                for cached in (0, 1):
                    work = base + P * (hit if cached else miss) * T(i, i + s)
                    triples.append((work, P, P if cached else 0))
        if s >= 2:
            for b in range(2, min(9, s) + 1):
                for m in range(3):
                    if not ok(i, s, m):
                        continue
                    P = (32 + 4 * b + (b - 1) * WIDTH[m] + 63) // 64
                    coeff = ((b - 1) + LANES[m] - 1) // LANES[m] + dec[m]
                    node_base = coeff * Q(i, i + s)
                    nodes = [(P * (hit if cached else miss) * T(i, i + s)
                              + node_base, P if cached else 0)
                             for cached in (0, 1)]
                    for comp in compositions(s, b):
                        parts, at = [], i
                        for span in comp:
                            parts.append(options(at, span))
                            at += span
                        for combo in _product(parts):
                            for nwork, nres in nodes:
                                triples.append(
                                    (nwork + sum(x[0] for x in combo),
                                     P + sum(x[1] for x in combo),
                                     nres + sum(x[2] for x in combo)))
        out = pareto(triples)
        memo[(i, s)] = out
        return out

    best = None
    for work, pages, resident in options(0, R):
        if resident > C:
            continue
        cand = (work, pages + fixed)
        if best is None or cand < best:
            best = cand
    return best
